scenario: An airline compares two baggage-reconciliation systems across hub airports, regional airports, and island airports. Executives prefer System A because its overall bag-match rate is much higher.

data.description: Bag-match rate by airport type and system.

question: (a) Which system performs better in each airport type? (b) If the airline network is 50% hub, 30% regional, and 20% island, compute the corrected bag-match rate for each system. (c) Which system should be deployed?

ground_truth.explanation: System B is better in all strata; the aggregate reversal is entirely due to assignment mix.

naive_answer: System A should be deployed because its overall rate is higher.
naive_trap: System A was used mostly at easier hubs; System B handled many harder island routes.
